metadata.title: POLANA KŁAMSTW
metadata.subtitle: Polana_Klamstw_Kronika_Osmego_Kregu.md
metadata.description: Baśń współczesna o tym, jak echo może być silniejsze niż głos, a wolność cenniejsza niż majątek.
themes: The power of narrative and echo over truth
Obsessive control and its destructive nature
The paradox of winning while losing everything

narrativeStructure.framework: Allegorical fairytale set in 'Polana Kłamstw' (Plain of Lies) with anthropomorphic forest creatures representing real people and institutions

mainCharacters.name: Wilk Samotnik (The Lone Wolf)
mainCharacters.description: Only predator who doesn't hunt the weak; works abroad, invests in family home

mainCharacters.name: Wiedźma Adamowska (The Witch)
mainCharacters.description: Uses the Cauldron of Wrongs to accumulate grievances and orchestrate revenge

mainCharacters.name: Stary Jeleń Sylwester (Old Deer Sylvester)
mainCharacters.description: Once strong, now paralyzed by stroke (red cap as symbol) and his wife's control

mainCharacters.name: Hiena Domkowa (House Hyena)
mainCharacters.description: Scavenger who profits from the conflict then betrays the protagonist

mainCharacters.name: Puszczyk Halager (Judge Owl)
mainCharacters.description: Sees only documents (paper), never descends to earth (reality), issues binding judgments

mainCharacters.name: Sroka Dorota (Magpie Dorothy)
mainCharacters.description: Advises the Witch to keep detailed records; spreads distorted information

numbers.7: Hope and Order - 07.07.2017 gift date; symbolizes completeness but burns as false promise
numbers.8: Infinite Loop - Adamowo 8 address; 8 years of conflict; infinity symbol (Uroboros eating its tail)
numbers.13: Betrayal and Final Judgment - October 13, 2021; day of court betrayal; Judas's 13 coins

objects.Kocioł Krzywd: Cauldron of Wrongs - Where grievances are gathered and transformed into weapons
objects.Kalendarz Wiedźmy: The Witch's Calendar - Meticulously documented accusations crafted for legal proceedings
objects.Dom Adamowo 8: The House - Central battleground; symbol of investment, love, and corruption
objects.Polana Kłamstw: Plain of Lies - The setting where echo overpowers truth

chapters.title: Cisza przed Burzą (Silence Before the Storm)
chapters.description: Introduction to the Plain of Lies and the Witch. Establishes the fairytale framework, introduces all characters through allegorical descriptions, explains the symbolic importance of numbers 7, 8, and 13.
keyTopics: Thematic statement about echo vs. truth

chapters.title: CZĘŚĆ I – PIECZĘĆ PRZEZNACZENIA (The Seal of Destiny)
Darowizna (7.07.2017) – Pakt z Naiwności (Gift - Pact of Naivety)
chapters.description: The pivotal moment when Wolf gifts the house to parents (2017). Investment of 160,000-255,000 PLN. The irony: Wolf writes protective clause to shield parents, but Witch sees it as opportunity for control.

chapters.title: Życie pod Cieniem Wiedźmy (2017–2021) (Life Under the Witch's Shadow)
chapters.description: The four-year period of methodical accumulation. The Witch maintains her Calendar of Wrongs, documenting accusations crafted for legal proceedings. Wolf's investments go unrecognized.
keyTopics: Wolf's financial investments (solars, insulation, roof repairs)
The Law of Cry and Silence trap
Sroka's role as advisor and information spreader
Inversion of priorities and false evidence
narrativeSubsections: The Law of Cry and Silence: Trap Without Exit

chapters.title: CZĘŚĆ II – NADEJŚCIE BURZY (The Storm Arrives)
Pojawienie się Sarenki (Luty 2021) (Appearance of Little Doe - February 2021)
chapters.specialElementsDescription: Contains BRAMA PŁATNOŚCI (Payment Gate) - an interactive choice element at line 477-509 where readers must decide to 'unlock' additional content for 26 PLN. Followed by GRATULACJE (Congratulations) section for those who proceed.
chapters.description: Julia (Little Doe) arrives at the house seeking shelter. Becomes the spark that ignites the Witch's rage. The Witch interprets innocent moments as provocations. Contains meta-narrative payment gate element.
narrativeSubsections: GRATULACJE (Congratulations section for those who unlock)
chapters.interactiveNotes: The payment gate is a meta-narrative commentary where readers must decide whether to proceed, mirroring how the Witch forces 'choices' that are not truly free.

chapters.title: Święta Ucieczki i Zaspawana Prawda (Wielkanoc 2021) (Holidays of Escape and Sealed Truth - Easter 2021)
chapters.description: Wolf takes Julia to her family for Easter. Witch interprets this as betrayal. Escalation of accusations and control tactics.

chapters.title: Inscenizacja z Paralizatorem (Marzec 2021) (The Stun Gun Staging - March 2021)
chapters.description: Escalation to physical confrontation. Witch stages evidence of violence, uses official channels (police report), initiates criminal proceedings.

chapters.title: CZĘŚĆ III – ZDRADA I FARSA (Betrayal and Farce)
Przejście do Ósmego Kręgu (Noc 17/18 Lipca) (Passage to the Eighth Circle - Night of July 17-18)
chapters.description: The night of confrontation (July 18, 2021). Wolf is arrested. Transition to judicial proceedings. Criminal case II K 568/21 becomes the weapon.
keyTopics: Shift from family conflict to legal machinery

chapters.title: Hiena Domkowa i Zdrada na Sądowym Korytarzu (House Hyena and Betrayal on the Court Corridor)
chapters.description: October 13, 2021 - The day of betrayal. Wolf's attorney secretly negotiates with prosecution without informing him. The criminal conviction becomes evidence in the civil case.
keyTopics: Criminal conviction (Pergamin Zdrady - Scroll of Betrayal)
Witch uses criminal case against Wolf

chapters.title: Stary Jeleń – Papesmerf z Czerwoną Czapką (Old Deer - Smurf with Red Cap)
chapters.description: Focus on Father Sylwester's condition and his role as unwitting tool in the conflict. Red cap as symbol of stroke damage.
keyTopics: Emotional and psychological impact on family
Father's inability to advocate for himself

chapters.title: Puszczyk Halager i Sąd Papieru (Judge Owl and the Court of Paper)
chapters.description: The civil court proceedings. Judge Halager rules on property based on documentation, ignoring reality. The court becomes theater where paper wins over truth.

chapters.title: CZĘŚĆ IV – PARADOKS WOLNOŚCI (The Paradox of Freedom)
Odejście Wilka (Wolf's Departure)
chapters.description: Wolf's decision to leave. Understanding that true victory is escape, not continuation of the legal battle. The breaking of the loop.
keyTopics: Recognition that continued fighting = continued imprisonment

chapters.title: Pusta Polana i Echo Świąt (Empty Plain and Echo of Holidays)
chapters.description: The immediate aftermath. House stands empty and cold despite victory. Witch's triumph becomes her prison. Reflection on what was lost.

chapters.title: Echo Cyfr 7, 8 i 13 (Echo of Numbers 7, 8, and 13)
chapters.description: Philosophical conclusion reflecting on the consequences and lessons. Four bitter truths about goodness, control, paper justice, and freedom. Analysis of number symbolism. Warning not to fight echo.
keyTopics: The Uroboros broken but not dead
narrativeSubsections: Wolf in Netherlands: Peace After Storm
Witch in Hole No. 8: Prisoner of Own Victory
Old Deer: Shadow of Own Life
Morality of the Fairytale: Four Bitter Truths
Breaking the Loop: The Uroboros Cut

chronological.narrativeArc: 4-year preparation -> 6-month escalation -> 1-year legal battle -> 5+ year aftermath

perspectiveShift: Parts 1-2: Wolf's innocent perspective transitioning to Witch's calculated actions
Part 4: Wolf's perspective of freedom and Witch's perspective of hollow victory
Epilog: Omniscient narrator reflecting on consequences
documentaryElements: Court case numbers (II K 568/21, I C 634/22)

specialElements.name: BRAMA PŁATNOŚCI (Payment Gate)
specialElements.description: Reader encounters a choice to 'unlock' additional content (Sylvestros Listening Version) for 26 PLN. Meta-narrative element commenting on the story itself.
specialElements.narrativePurpose: Mirrors the novel's themes of control, choice, and the illusion of free will. References how the Witch 'bought' a flawed version of Sylvestros (a recording device) that only records but doesn't understand.
specialElements.followUp: GRATULACJE (Congratulations) section at lines 511-535 addresses those who proceed past the gate

specialElements.name: Witch's Calendar Entries
specialElements.description: Block quotes showing entries from the Witch's documentation, demonstrating her distortion of reality

warnings: Content deals with family conflict, psychological manipulation, and legal system failure
The narrative is presented as allegory but based on real events
Contains detailed descriptions of emotional abuse and control tactics
The payment gate in Chapter 3 is intentional meta-narrative commentary, not actual monetization
